bullets: On Tuesday 10 November, Dubai recorded 475 sales worth AED 1.6bn, which is 5.0% below a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 52.2% of Tuesday's sales, compared to 58.6% over the last seven days.
The median price was AED 1,672 per sq ft, flat against the 30-day average and down 4.9% from last year.
JVC led 7-day sales with 195 transactions, followed by Dubai South with 172 and Dubai Land Residence with 135.
In October new rental contracts, a 1BR apartment in JVC had a median rent of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Gold dipped under $4,000 amid a strong dollar and rate hike bets, which shifts global interest rate expectations and directly influences borrowing costs and investor sentiment.
UAE corporate tax revenue reached $12.7 billion, reflecting the changing fiscal landscape for businesses operating in the UAE.
S&P forecasts a 20% Dubai residential supply rise by 2028, and these market supply forecasts and potential price corrections directly influence buyer sentiment and investment timing.
